title: Spec #2 — n8n Graph Extraction Step
description: Add graph extraction node to n8n ingest pipeline. After summarization: generate UUID chunk IDs, call llama3.2 via Kong to extract {concepts[], relationships[], events[]}, write Document/Chunk/Concept nodes to Neo4j, set neo4j_chunk_id in Qdrant payload. Fix Qdrant point IDs to be UUIDs.
acceptance_criteria:
- Ingest markdown triggers graph extraction without error
- Document node created in Neo4j after ingest
- Chunk nodes linked to Document via [:PART_OF]
- >= 1 Concept node extracted and linked via [:MENTIONS]
- All Qdrant point IDs are valid UUIDs
- neo4j_chunk_id in Qdrant payload matches Neo4j Chunk.id
- Malformed LLM JSON falls back to empty arrays (no crash)
- Pipeline is idempotent (no duplicate nodes on re-ingest)
- All Spec #1 integration tests still pass

title: Spec #7 — Audio Overview
description: Add podcast-style audio overview capability. query/audio.py generates a host+guest format script via llama3.2 (min 200 words). TTS via local Coqui TTS or Ollama TTS. POST /audio-overview FastAPI endpoint. audio_overview MCP tool wrapping the endpoint.
acceptance_criteria:
- POST /audio-overview returns {script, audio_path, duration_seconds}
- Script is >= 200 words in host/guest podcast format
- audio_path points to a valid local audio file
- audio_overview MCP tool callable from Claude Desktop and returns same response shape
- mypy --strict passes on query/audio.py
- Unit tests cover script generation with mocked LLM
- Integration test: call endpoint against real stack, verify audio file exists

title: Spec #6 — Full Test Suite
description: Complete all four test layers: MCP Jest unit + integration + contract tests for all 7 tools. Query pytest unit + integration tests for rag, graph, hybrid modules. E2E tests (3 total, one per notebook): ingest doc -> query -> verify citation returned with neo4j_chunk_id.
acceptance_criteria:
- Jest unit tests: all 7 MCP tools covered, all deps mocked, >= 80% line coverage
- Jest integration tests: all 7 tools called against real services
- Jest contract tests: Zod schema validation for all tool inputs/outputs (valid + invalid + edge cases)
- pytest unit tests: rag.py, graph.py, hybrid.py fully covered with mocks
- pytest integration tests: test_qdrant.py, test_neo4j.py, test_query_endpoint.py all green
- E2E tests: kong.e2e.test.ts, personal.e2e.test.ts, music.e2e.test.ts all pass
- npm test and pytest both exit 0 with no skips masking failures

title: Spec #1 — Neo4j Infrastructure
description: Add Neo4j 5 Community to docker-compose, create constraints/indexes via init-neo4j.py, create Qdrant collections via init-qdrant.py. Foundation for all graph and vector operations.
acceptance_criteria:
- Neo4j container healthy in docker-compose
- init-neo4j.py creates 4 constraints + 3 range indexes + 1 full-text index (idempotent)
- init-qdrant.py creates kong/personal/music collections (768-dim Cosine, idempotent)
- All 21 integration tests green

title: Spec #3 — Query Service (FastAPI + GraphRAG)
description: Build the Python FastAPI query service implementing hybrid GraphRAG retrieval. Modules: rag.py (Qdrant vector search), graph.py (Neo4j concept extraction + traversal), hybrid.py (merge + re-rank at 60/40 split), main.py (endpoints: /query, /health, /collections, graph CRUD). Dockerized and added to docker-compose.
acceptance_criteria:
- GET /health returns 200
- POST /query returns {answer, citations[], concepts_used[]} for a seeded document
- Citations include neo4j_chunk_id linking back to Neo4j
- Hybrid re-ranking formula applied: (qdrant_score * 0.6) + (1/hop_distance * 0.4)
- mypy --strict passes on all query/ modules
- pytest unit tests pass with all deps mocked
- pytest integration tests pass against real Qdrant + Neo4j
- Docker image builds and service is healthy in docker-compose

title: Spec #4 — MCP Server
description: Build the TypeScript MCP server exposing all 7 tools: ingest_document, query, search_concepts, add_relationship, list_notebooks, get_document_graph, audio_overview. Dual transport (stdio/SSE via MCP_TRANSPORT env var). Clients: FastAPI, Qdrant direct, Neo4j direct. Env var validation at startup (fail-fast). Dockerized.
acceptance_criteria:
- All 7 MCP tools callable from Claude Desktop via stdio transport
- MCP_TRANSPORT=sse starts HTTP/SSE server on MCP_PORT
- config.ts fails fast with clear error on missing env vars
- Zod schemas define and validate all tool inputs/outputs
- tsc --strict compiles with zero errors
- Jest unit tests pass (all deps mocked)
- Jest integration tests pass against real services
- Jest contract tests validate all tool schemas
- Docker image builds and service is healthy in docker-compose
- claude_desktop_config.json snippet documented

title: Spec #5 — Kong MCP Gateway Route
description: Add /notebooklm/mcp/* route to kong/kong-ollama.yaml decK config. Plugins: ai-mcp-proxy (routes SSE to MCP server port 3000), key-auth, http-log. Validate with deck diff before deck sync.
acceptance_criteria:
- POST /notebooklm/mcp/* proxied to MCP server SSE endpoint
- key-auth plugin enforces API key on all MCP requests
- http-log plugin logs all MCP traffic
- deck diff shows zero drift after deck sync
- Tool call via Kong SSE returns identical result to stdio transport
